description: This file defines the NormalizeRecords class, which extends BatchJob, and manages the process of normalizing string fields in database records across multiple modules in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for job execution, configuration management, database querying, and record processing to ensure string normalization consistency.

classes.name: NormalizeRecords
classes.description: Extends BatchJob to perform system-wide normalization of string fields in database records for specified modules, including setup, execution, and record processing.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Executes the full normalization process across modules, managing job state and progress tracking.

methods.name: getJobKey
methods.description: Returns a unique key identifier for this job type.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes job environment and user context.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the normalization job should proceed based on current repair status.

methods.name: getRepairStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current repair status from system settings.

methods.name: setRepairStatus
methods.description: Sets the repair status in system settings.

methods.name: getExecutionMode
methods.description: Fetches the current execution mode (sync/async).

methods.name: setExecutionMode
methods.description: Sets the execution mode of the job (sync/async).

methods.name: isValidRepairFrom
methods.description: Validates the provided repair start date string.

methods.name: getConfigEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration setting from the admin settings.

methods.name: setConfigEntry
methods.description: Stores a configuration setting in the admin settings.

methods.name: setupTracking
methods.description: Prepares tracking data for module normalization.

methods.name: getAllIdsInRange
methods.description: Fetches record IDs from a module modified or entered after a specified date.

methods.name: repairChunk
methods.description: Processes a batch of records, normalizing string fields and saving changes.

methods.name: repairStringValues
methods.description: Normalizes string fields in a database row based on defined rules.

methods.name: getRepairableFieldNames
methods.description: Identifies text-based fields eligible for normalization in a given module.

methods.name: getRecordChunk
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of records from the database based on IDs.

methods.name: debugLog
methods.description: Logs debugging information.

methods.name: echoOutput
methods.description: Outputs status messages when echo mode is enabled.

methods.name: getModulesToNormalize
methods.description: Returns a list of modules targeted for normalization, including additional modules.
